title: US Justice Department Subpoena Journalist Over North Korea Leak Probe
summary: The US Justice Department subpoenaed freelancer Matthew Cole in February, seeking over two years' worth of his notes and testimony. The subpoena was issued by Virginia prosecutors as part of a probe into the New York Times' coverage of a North Korea story. The Justice Department faces criticism for its increasing use of subpoenas to compel journalists to reveal information.
summary_points: US Justice Department subpoenaed freelancer Matthew Cole in February
Subpoena sought over two years' worth of Cole's notes and testimony
Virginia prosecutors issued the subpoena as part of a probe into the New York Times' coverage of a North Korea story
